item.tib: dbal gyi khyung chen drag po'i sgrub pa dregs pa zil gnon sde brgyad dbang sdud
item.coloph: ces pa'i khyung sgrub dregs pa zil gnon sde brgyad dbang bsdud 'di yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa hor sog sde'i tha grur gnas pa'i a 'tsho grwa pa sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyis dar dkar lha gos srid ring dang / rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo rten 'brel legs shar gyi rtags bkra ba yis sna drangs nas ring po'i dus nas bskul pa dang*/ phyis su bzhod ston dngos grub grags pa'i skye ba 'dzin pa'i/ shel btsun tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis nye bar bskul ba la bstan (brten) nas/ rgyal khams gyi khol po ba sprang phal pa ci lta ba/ tshe dbang rjes 'brang / tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ lha mchog rig 'dzin stong rgyung gyi (gi) zhal lung ji bzhin du/ zo dor nor bu lha rtse'i mdun zhol/ g.yu lung shel brag mngon dga'i g.yon zur/ rig 'dzin nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i g.yas zur/ shar grol smin gling dgon du dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'dis kyang / sde brgyad dregs tshogs zil gyis gnon pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
